datasheet_identity.title: BZT52C2V0 THRU BZT52C75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: The BZT52C24 electrical-characteristics row specifies VZ minimum 22.80 V, nominal 24.0 V, and maximum 25.20 V at IZT = 5 mA and TA = 25 degC; the nominal reverse zener voltage and test current are represented as the typical breakdown pair.
The same row specifies maximum ZZT = 70 ohm at IZT = 5 mA and maximum ZZK = 250 ohm at IZK = 1 mA; these impedance values are not representable in the strict schema.

The Fig. 2 points are manual digitizations of visible points on the curve explicitly labeled 24. Voltage and current are reported as positive reverse-bias magnitudes while polarity is stated in the curve conditions; the current axis is logarithmic.
The maximum-rating page states PD = 350 mW, while the p. 3 plot annotation states PD = 500 mW; both source values are preserved and no derating parameter is inferred.
The datasheet provides no numeric target-specific capacitance value at a stated bias and test frequency; the p. 3 capacitance plot is a family-level multi-curve figure, so specs.capacitance is null.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time specification; reverse_recovery is null.
omission_reason: No numeric target-specific capacitance or reverse-recovery value is stated; the family-level capacitance plot was not converted into a single BZT52C24 scalar without a directly attributable tabulated point at specified bias and frequency.
